caption:
Things that can look like ADHD, and why a careful assessment checks for them.

Focus, memory and restlessness can shift with sleep, health and mood. Sleep problems can bring symptoms that look like ADHD. Hearing or vision problems, thyroid conditions, anaemia and some medicines or stimulants can affect attention. PTSD, anxiety and low mood overlap with ADHD, and can also occur alongside it. Research on ADHD and perimenopause has barely begun.

Australian guidelines ask clinicians to check for these before, and alongside, an ADHD diagnosis. That is why our assessment includes a health and sleep history, and a letter for your GP about anything worth checking.

Part of our series, ADHD: the full picture.
